<div class="card-body">
'''I'm Here To Rescue You''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">助けに来ました。</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：「監房ブロック通路」に自分のスパイがいる場合に使用する。運命数を引く。運命数＋スパイの能力値＞捕虜の能力値なら、その捕虜を脱出させる。そうでなければ、スパイは捕虜になる。2：「ケッセルのスパイス鉱床」をキャンセルする（目標となった捕虜を脱出させる）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Im-Here-To-Rescue-You-SWCA-67668.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「はあ？」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' I've Come to Help.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use if you have a spy at Detention Block Corridor. Draw destiny. If destiny + the spy's ability > the captive's ability, release that captive. Otherwise the spy is captured.

2: Cancel Spice Mines Of Kessel (releasing the targeted captive).

'''Lore:'''
“Huh?”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 助けに来ました。 (I've come to help). The Japanese numbers the two options.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I'm Here To Rescue You]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
